datasets.name: Poland - Geoportal standard orthophoto
datasets.attribution: Glowny Urzad Geodezji i Kartografii (GUGiK), Geoportal.gov.pl
datasets.license: Use according to the terms published by Geoportal.gov.pl
datasets.information: Current standard-resolution Polish orthophoto mosaic. At 4096, TSRE composes four parallel 2048-pixel exports for faster loading; the lower quality choices use one request. Cached images expire after 30 days because the service is updated over time.

datasets.name: World - ESA WorldCover Sentinel-2 RGB 2021
datasets.attribution: ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by the ESA WorldCover consortium
datasets.information: Global display-ready true-colour Sentinel-2 mosaic. Acquisition is capped near the product's useful 10 m resolution.

datasets.name: United States (contiguous) - USGS imagery (fast cached ~2 m)
datasets.attribution: USDA, USGS The National Map: Orthoimagery
datasets.license: Public Domain for the configured contiguous-US NAIP coverage
datasets.information: Official cached USGS imagery basemap, predominantly USDA NAIP over the contiguous United States. Source imagery is primarily 0.6 m, but the published cache ends at zoom 16 and supplies roughly 1.5-2.2 m ground pixels across this coverage. Cached tiles expire after 30 days because the mosaic is updated over time.

datasets.name: United States (contiguous) - USGS NAIP Plus (0.5-2 m)
datasets.attribution: USGS, USDA, The National Map: Orthoimagery
datasets.license: Public Domain for the configured contiguous-US NAIP coverage
datasets.information: Official dynamic USGS NAIP Plus ImageServer. Choose 4000 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4000 mode composes four parallel 2000-pixel exports. Source imagery varies from about 0.15 m to 1 m and is served in natural colour. High-resolution requests take longer than the separate cached USGS source.

datasets.name: Czechia - CUZK Ortofoto CR (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.attribution: Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre (CUZK)
datasets.information: Official Ortofoto CR Web Mercator export service. The source product has 12.5 cm pixels and a two-year national update cycle. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode composes four parallel 2048-pixel exports, replacing hundreds of individual WMTS tile requests.

datasets.name: Netherlands - PDOK current RGB aerial imagery (0.5-2 m requests)
datasets.information: Official current nationwide 25 cm RGB aerial-photo mosaic. The Actueel layer follows the most recent complete national year. Choose 4096 for approximately 0.5 m terrain pixels, 2048 for 1 m, or 1024 for 2 m. The 4096 mode uses four parallel WMS blocks because PDOK limits each image to 2500 pixels per side.
